symbols.name: first input sequence
symbols.meaning: The first of the two input sequences, of length $n$.
symbols.quote: Let $a$ and $b$ be two input sequences, and let $n$ be the number of entries in each, so $a=(a_0,\dots,a_{n-1})$ and $b=(b_0,\dots,b_{n-1})$.

symbols.name: second input sequence
symbols.meaning: The second of the two input sequences, of length $n$.
symbols.quote: Let $a$ and $b$ be two input sequences, and let $n$ be the number of entries in each, so $a=(a_0,\dots,a_{n-1})$ and $b=(b_0,\dots,b_{n-1})$.

symbols.name: entries per input
symbols.meaning: The number of entries in each input sequence.
symbols.quote: Let $a$ and $b$ be two input sequences, and let $n$ be the number of entries in each, so $a=(a_0,\dots,a_{n-1})$ and $b=(b_0,\dots,b_{n-1})$.

symbols.name: output position
symbols.meaning: The position of an entry of the convolution output.
symbols.quote: Here $t$ is the position of an output entry, and $i$ and $j$ are positions of input entries, with $i$ in $a$ and $j$ in $b$.

symbols.name: input position in a
symbols.meaning: The position of an entry of $a$.
symbols.quote: Here $t$ is the position of an output entry, and $i$ and $j$ are positions of input entries, with $i$ in $a$ and $j$ in $b$.

symbols.name: input position in b
symbols.meaning: The position of an entry of $b$.
symbols.quote: Here $t$ is the position of an output entry, and $i$ and $j$ are positions of input entries, with $i$ in $a$ and $j$ in $b$.

symbols.name: convolution
symbols.meaning: The convolution of $a$ and $b$, a sequence of length $2n-1$.
